jobs.sanitizedComment:
We are looking for a Financial Analyst to support planning and business decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Build financial models and forecasts
  • Prepare budgets and variance reports
  • Analyse business and unit performance
  • Support leadership with financial insights

Requirements

  • 1+ years in financial analysis or FP&A
  • Advanced Excel and modelling skills
  • CA, CFA or MBA Finance is a plus
